text: よくきたな　おまえさんの　ポケモンは　げんき　じゃぞ

structure.jp: おまえさんの　ポケモンは

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the way old people in stories say だ, 'is'. げんき　じゃ = 'is doing well'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end pushes the statement at the listener in a rough, confident way. げんき　じゃぞ = 'it's doing well, I tell you'.
